prompt_text: You have 12 identical-looking coins. One is counterfeit and may be either heavier or lighter than the real coins. You have a balance scale. Determine the minimum number of weighings needed to guarantee identifying the counterfeit coin and whether it is heavier or lighter. Provide a general strategy and prove that your solution is optimal or explain why a better solution is impossible.
notes: Provided information-theoretic proof of optimality. Gave explicit weighing plan with 12 coins.
